title: addNumericRefinement does not allow multiple operators
body:
I want to put multiple numeric filters with different operators and do an or between all of them.

# Currently 

```helper.addNumericRefinement('rooms', '=', ['42', '56', '37'] ).search();```

# Expected 

```helper.addNumericRefinement('rooms',  ['=42', '=56', '>=37'] ).search();```

comments.body:
This is not possible with the numeric refinements method indeed, but it is possible with raw filters:

```
helper.addQueryParameter('filters', 'rooms=42 OR rooms=56 OR rooms>=37')
```

@Haroenv Thanks for you reply

This approach won't work if you have any other regular numeric filter:

If you use `helper.addQueryParameter` and then use any regular numeric filter you'll get the following error:

 `[Numeric filters] Can't switch from the advanced to the managed API. It is probably an error, if this is really what you want, you have to first clear the numeric filters.`

 and viceversa:

 `[Numeric filters] Can't switch from the managed API to the advanced. It is probably an error, if this is really what you want, you have to first clear the numeric filters.`

Is there anything someone can use to get it to work ?
You will indeed have to use the query parameters method for the whole interaction with that filter if you do so.
